title: security-compliance-review-prep-1on1
content:
Purpose: prep notes for 1:1 w/ Ben (audit lead) to align on SOC2/ISO readiness, vendor risk items, and near-term audit action list. Quick goal: leave meeting with clear owners and dates for evidence collection and vendor attestations.

Background/context:
- We kicked off SOC2 readiness program Q4 2025; initial gap assessment done by external consultant (summary in confluence link).
- ISO27001 scoping decision pending for control scope (hosted control plane + customer data paths).
- Several high-risk vendors (identity provider, secrets manager, some observability/toast services) require updated attestations.

Agenda (20–30m):
1) Status roundup (5m) — quick ticks on SOC2 in-scope systems, ISO scope decision, and open evidence buckets.
2) Vendor risk (8m) — top 5 vendors with missing artifacts, who to chase, escalation plan.
3) Evidence collection plan (8m) — owners for policy docs, configs, logs, interviews, and retention windows.
4) Audit logistics & timeline (5m) — readiness gate for external auditor run, blackout windows, point-of-contact list.
5) Action alignment & next check-in (2m).

Key points to raise / reminders:
- Evidence buckets still missing: privileged access review logs (IAM console screenshots + rollout notes), encryption key rotation evidence from KMS, and retention configuration exports for logging pipeline.
- Need to confirm whether Dedicated customers' on-prem packages fall inside ISO scope (affects SoA).
- External consultant recommended a continuous evidence collection cadence (weekly snapshots) to avoid last-minute scramble. We should budget for 2 weeks of extra SRE time during audit window.
- Vendor attestations: request fresh SOC2 reports or ISO certs for vendors where we rely on control coverage (esp. IDP, KMS, and Cloud infra provider). For those without reports, ensure compensating controls documented in vendor risk register.

Draft vendor chase list (priority):
- Auth0 (IDP) — need SOC2 Type II 2025 report or written attestation on multi-tenant isolation and SCIM provisioning logs. Owner: Priya. Target: 2026-03-08.
- KeySafe (KMS vendor) — confirm key rotation policy evidence and HSM certs. Owner: Ben. Target: 2026-03-05.
- ObservabilityCo — clarify log retention snapshots and access control for log ingest pipeline. Owner: James. Target: 2026-03-10.
- Payments processor — confirm PCI scope separation and SOC2 status; escalate if not provided. Owner: Maya. Target: 2026-03-12.
- Infra partner (cloud region partner) — request ISO27001 cert + SOC2 if applicable. Owner: Ben. Target: 2026-03-15.

Evidence collection checklist (work-in-progress):
- Policies: info sec policy, access control policy, vendor management policy — PDF exports + sign-off dates. (Owner: Maya)
- Logs: examples of retention config, snapshot of S3 buckets/log retention, central logging ACLs. (Owner: James)
action_items: Priya: request Auth0 SOC2 Type II 2025 report by 2026-03-08
Ben: obtain KeySafe rotation evidence + HSM certs by 2026-03-05
James: export observability retention config + ACLs by 2026-03-10
Maya: follow up with payments processor and escalate if no attestation by 2026-03-12
Ben: request infra partner ISO cert + SOC2 report by 2026-03-15
Maya/Priya: prepare vendor risk exception write-ups for any missing attestations by 2026-03-18
All: sync next check-in 2026-03-09 to review progress
